mentions.name: East Bay Makers Club
mentions.description: A non-profit 501(c)(3) maker space in Berkeley open to the local maker community, open noon to midnight and equipped with 3D printers, laser cutters, CNC machines, and a full electronics bench.
mentions.source_excerpt: Opening a new maker space in Berkeley, July 3rd Noon-Midnight. Founded by 2 guys in a basement 9 years ago. Now opening it up to the community of local makers as a non-profit 501(c)(3). 3D print, laser cutters, CNC, full e-bench.
